events.headline: Westbound Interstate 90 is open to two lanes at milepost 174, at Hansen Road just west of Moses Lake, while eastbound I-90 is open to one lane from Aug. 24 until January of 2027. Eastbound travelers heading north or south of Hansen Road must use Exit 169 at Hiawatha Road. Westbound travelers heading north may use exit 174. Travelers heading south must use exit 169 and follow the South Frontage Road detour.

From 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. nightly Sunday night, Nov. 8, through Monday morning, Nov. 16, the eastbound I-90 ramps to northbound and southbound I-405 will close for construction. Signed detours will be available.
Shoulder Closure on I-90 eastbound near MP Marker 273 beginning at 7:00 am on November 13, 2026 until about 10:00 am. for silt removal.
The westbound Winchester rest area on I90 at milepost 161.83 will be closed for maintenance until further notice.
From 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. nightly Sunday night, Nov. 8, through Monday morning, Nov. 16, the eastbound I-90 on-ramp from East Mercer Way will close for construction. Signed detours will be available.

From 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. nightly Sunday night, Nov. 8, through Monday morning, Nov. 16, the eastbound I-90 on-ramp from Bellevue Way Southeast will close for construction. Signed detours will be available.

The eastbound I-90 off-ramp to Factoria Boulevard will be closed overnight from 9 p.m. – 8 a.m.,
starting the night of Saturday, Nov. 14 to the morning of Sunday, Nov. 15. A signed detour will be in
place

Single right lane closure on I-90 eastbound at milepost 270.6 near SR 904 beginning at 8:30 pm on November 13, 2026 until about 3:00 am on November 14, 2026 for concrete barrier replacement. Speed limit reduced to 55 MPH.

The eastbound I-90 off-ramp to Factoria Boulevard will be closed overnight from 9 p.m. – 7 a.m.,
starting the night of Friday, Nov. 13 to the morning of Saturday, Nov. 14. A signed detour will be in
place.
